# Overwatch Retail Patch Notes – November 19, 2020

> 日期: 2020-11-19 · 站点: en · 来源: https://overwatch.blizzard.com/en-us/news/patch-notes/live/2020/11

## General Updates

### General

Support heroes no longer say "Group up with me" when they are missing health and request healing

## Hero Updates

### Ana（支援）

*开发者注：A significant number of Biotic Grenades are blocked by allies accidentally intercepting it. Having it collide with allies in the same manner as Ana's primary fire will enable more deliberate placement of the ability.*

#### Biotic Grenade
- Projectile now passes through allies with full health

### Brigitte（支援）

*开发者注：Brigitte was a likely candidate when looking at close range heroes to receive a health adjustment while experimenting with 25 HP increments. This ended up being too powerful when combined with her self-healing and barrier.*

- Base health reduced from 175 to 150

### Hanzo（输出）

#### Storm Arrows
- Can now be manually canceled

### Mei（输出）

#### Ice Wall
- Can now be manually destroyed while dead

### Moira（支援）

*开发者注：Moira could use a small bump in healing efficiency after recent changes made maintaining her high healing output more challenging.*

#### Biotic Grasp
- Healing resource consumption rate lowered from 14 to 12.5

### Symmetra（输出）

#### Teleporter
- Can now be manually destroyed while dead

### Torbjörn

#### Deploy Turret
- Turret can now be manually destroyed while dead
